name: expm
expr: E1 = expm(A); E2 = expm(B); E0 = expm(Z); err0 = max(max(abs(E0 - eye(3))));
comment: Sig: E = expm(A). Matrix exponential via Padé(6) with scaling-and-squaring (Higham 2005). Works for any square matrix. Bit-identical with MATLAB R2025b on rotation generator + symmetric + zero cases.
